events.title: Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is in full swing, and Fallgrade is part of it! You can now try out the free demo. It focuses on the parkour section set in the urban environment, giving you a first taste of what Fallgrade has to offer.Give it a try, and let me know what you think. As a solo developer, your feedback and support mean a lot to me. Every wishlist, comment, and shared experience helps.Thanks for your support, and enjoy Steam Next Fest! See you in Fallgrade!

events.title: Jumping improved
events.summary: Hi! Jumping has been improved in the demo. Overall movement should now feel more precise and smoother. I hope you enjoy it, and thanks for your support!

events.title: Demo Improvements
events.summary: Hey! I've just released a small update to the demo.Alongside a few minor improvements (such as a Help option and the ability to set an even lower resolution for less powerful PCs), I've added a counter showing the number of remaining orbs. It now appears whenever you interact with them.But did you know that the remaining orbs are also tattooed on the main character's hands?

events.title: Demo Improvements & Steam Deck Support
events.summary: Hi, and a huge thank you to everyone who has already played the demo!I've made a small update to make it clearer that gravity can only be changed while stationary.I'm also primarily testing performance on the Steam Deck, as supporting the platform is personally very important to me.Once again, thank you so much for all your support!

events.title: Demo and Discord
events.summary: Hey, friends! I’ve finally finished the promised Fallgrade demo. It’s essentially a playable taste of the level from the teaser, so that video has now come to life as a fully playable experience!I’ve also set up a Discord server, and I’d really appreciate hearing your thoughts and feedback: https://discord.com/invite/yABryUAwGeHave a great one!
